Note: NIC 官方来源目录 / Curated official NIC driver source catalog. Each entry is a CONFIRMED OFFICIAL ENTRY POINT (download center / support portal / docs page) as of the AsOf date. It deliberately contains NO direct binary download URLs and NO SHA-256 hashes: those must be recorded by the operator at import time from the package they actually downloaded and verified. License notes reflect public licensing posture; the operator is responsible for confirming redistribution rights per package before marking a package redistributable. Default: packages from vendors not known to grant redistribution are NOT marked publishable (see NicBootstrapCatalog.RedistributionAllowed).

Vendors.Notes: Intel Ethernet adapter drivers are governed by the Intel Software License Agreement; some packages additionally require accepting a Limited Distribution License (LDL) before download. Redistribution is restricted; OEMs may redistribute under specific LDL terms. Confirm per package before marking redistributable.

Realtek publishes NIC drivers through its official download portal; the portal availability and direct links change over time. Many Realtek NIC drivers are distributed by system OEMs rather than directly. Confirm redistribution rights before bundling.
Broadcom NetXtreme/NetXtreme II drivers are available via Broadcom support; many downloads require a Broadcom support account or OEM entitlement. Redistribution restricted.
Qualcomm does not generally host end-user Atheros WLAN/NIC drivers; they must be acquired from the system OEM. No direct public download entry; treat as OEM-only.
MediaTek (which acquired Ralink) publishes networking product pages; end-user drivers are mostly distributed by OEMs. Treat as OEM acquisition required.

Marvell (which acquired Aquantia in 2019) hosts adapter drivers on its support downloads page; many require a Marvell support account. Aquantia AQtion 10G NICs use PCI vendor 1D6A; legacy Marvell uses 11AB.
Nvidia (which acquired Mellanox) distributes Windows OFED (WinOF/WinOF2) drivers for ConnectX adapters. Governed by the Nvidia networking driver license; confirm redistribution terms per package.
ASIX publishes USB-to-LAN (AX88179/AX88772/AX88772B/AX88179A) drivers on its products page. License terms apply; confirm redistribution rights before bundling.
Microchip (which acquired SMSC in 2012) hosts LAN95xx/LAN97xx USB Ethernet drivers via its development tools search. SMSC USB NICs use VID 0424.

virtio-win NetKVM drivers for KVM/QEMU virtual NICs (PCI vendor 1AF4) are part of the Fedora virtio-win project and are publicly redistributable under their GPL/BSD-style license. Obtain the virtio-win ISO from the official Fedora virtio-win project; the operator records the verified package hash at import time.
VMware vmxnet3 / vlance virtual NIC drivers (PCI vendor 15AD) ship in-box with VMware Tools; there is no standalone redistributable driver package. Install via VMware Tools under its EULA.
Hyper-V virtual NIC (netvsc, PCI vendor 1414) drivers ship in-box with Windows; no separate download is required or distributed. Listed for coverage tracking only.
